image.alt: A drawing of the excavated settlement at Mehrgarh from above: a grid of rectangular sun-dried brick walls, partitioned into small rooms and compartments.

bins.alt: A close view of excavated Mehrgarh walls: small rectangular mud-brick rooms beside long compartmentalised storage bins, all built of the same handmade sun-dried brick laid in even courses.

valley.alt: The Bolan river valley in Baluchistan: a narrow green river corridor running down between arid rocky hills toward the open plain, with excavated mud-brick wall stumps in the foreground.
